sections.Profile:
The "Guns N' Roses" pinball machine, released by Data East in July 1994, is a rock-themed game designed to capture the energy and excitement of the iconic band. This widebody machine, designed by Joe Kaminkow, John Borg, and Lyman F. Sheats Jr., features art by Markus Rothkranz and contributions from band members Slash and Axl Rose on the music and sound effects.
